title: DCP Helper Receipt (Envelope Only)
description: EXTERNAL_PROPOSED (DR-016) / PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT. Advisory only; a helper receipt cannot certify readiness. No repo-runtime helper-receipt artifact exists to validate against. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

provenance.description: Contract-level provenance per REV1 §6.0 meta-contract. EXTERNAL_PROPOSED: shape seeded by DR-016; no repo-runtime helper-receipt exists.

validation.description: Validation status per REV1 §6.0. PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT: envelope not cross-checked; no repo-runtime analog exists.

helper_receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this helper receipt.

helper_tool.description: Name of the helper tool or agent that produced this receipt.

helper_model.description: Model identifier of the helper (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5).

invocation_ref.description: Reference to the invocation record (e.g. session ID, task packet ID, conversation ref).

output_ref.description: Reference to the output artifact produced by the helper.

exit_code.description: Optional exit code from the helper invocation (null if not applicable).

mutation_performed.description: True if the helper performed a mutation. False for read-only analysis. Advisory: a helper receipt cannot self-certify readiness.

red_lane_flags.description: Red lane IDs that were flagged by or relevant to this helper invocation.

remaining_risks.description: Risks or uncertainties identified by the helper that remain unresolved.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance tags. DR-016 field vocab is EXTERNAL_PROPOSED; no repo-runtime analog exists for cross-check.

validation_state.description: PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT for all DR-016-derived helper receipts until repo-local vocab reconciliation.
